title: rsw-red-star-2009-championship
label: Alex Coslov

won.source: Named as the man Bone Smasher faced for the title on 7 April 2009; no date of his win survives, and the news does not say in so many words that he was champion before the match.

lost.source: Its 7 April 2009 news: the Bizarre Ministry then went on to vacant the RSW Title and fire Alex Coslov.

how: Standing champion as of the match for the title and the company on 7 April 2009, read from the news; the title was then vacated.

won.source: Named as the Tag Team Champions on the champions page and in the 7 April 2009 statement; no date of the win survives.

lost.source: No title change survives; the champions page still lists the team.

how: Tag Team Champions as of the champions page, whose win the owner said on 7 April 2009 would count if he wished it to.
